WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM END) AS avg_iga_igm_diff
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_pt,
        avg_iga_igm_diff,
        avg_iga_igm_diff / NULLIF(AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    ID,
    SEX,
    avg_pt,
    avg_iga_igm_diff,
    ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_ratios

UNION ALL

SELECT
    NULL AS ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt,
    AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff,
    AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_ratios
GROUP BY SEX
